description: This file implements network ping functionalities within the WPEFramework plugin namespace, including methods to perform ICMP pings to specified endpoints or named endpoints like 'CMTS', capturing and parsing the output of ping commands.

methods.name: JsonObject _doPing(const string & guid,const string & endPoint,int packets)
methods.description: Performs an ICMP ping to a given endpoint, parses the ping command output to gather statistics such as packet loss, min/avg/max round-trip times, and returns a JSON object with the results.

methods.name: JsonObject _doPingNamedEndpoint(const string & guid,const string & endpointName,int packets)
methods.description: Performs a ping to a named endpoint, such as 'CMTS', resolving it to an IP address or gateway, then calling _doPing to execute the ping.

ctags.name: _doPing
ctags.pattern: /^        JsonObject Network::_doPing(const string& guid, const string& endPoint, int packets)$/

ctags.name: _doPingNamedEndpoint
ctags.pattern: /^        JsonObject Network::_doPingNamedEndpoint(const string& guid, const string& endpointName,/
